conditioningLevel.rationale: Moderate conditioning fits several light-to-meaningful care routes: glyceryl oleate, fatty ester, hydrolyzed protein, panthenol and cationic guar.
conditioningLevel.counterSignal: No silicone or clearly rich 2-in-1 system is present, so high would overstate slip.

weightPotential.rationale: Moderate weight potential is plausible from interacting refatting, protein, fatty ester and cationic guar routes, but the absence of silicone and the SLES chassis keep it bounded.
weightPotential.counterSignal: No nonvolatile silicone route appears, and SLES at position 2 provides reset.

weightAssessment.whyThisBand: Several lighter routes interact, including refatter, protein and cationic guar, so some residue risk is plausible.
weightAssessment.whyNotNeighborBand: Low would understate the combined routes; high would require more persistent or richer deposition than this no-silicone formula shows.

focusPrimary.rationale: Gentle is final because revealed positioning explicitly says particularly mild cleansing/care for sensitive scalp, and the formula has compatible panthenol, niacinamide, refatting and no-silicone care routes despite SLES presence.
focusPrimary.counterSignal: Sodium Laureth Sulfate at position 2 and Parfum at position 6 keep the formula from being low-cleansing or fragrance-free mildness.

focusSecondary.rationale: No secondary focus is retained because no distinct blind-visible route can be separated from the same balanced care architecture.
focusSecondary.counterSignal: Protein and panthenol could later split into repair or gentle only if visible positioning distinguishes them.

usageRole.rationale: Regular is the default blind role because the formula is ordinary buffered sulfate cleansing without a treatment active or deep-reset architecture.
usageRole.counterSignal: Comfort clues could later support frequent use, but frequent requires visible daily/mild positioning and non-strong cleansing.

scalpComfortTarget.rationale: Targeted is final because revealed German positioning explicitly says sensitive scalp and mild care with calming ingredients and panthenol, and the formula includes panthenol/niacinamide comfort clues.
scalpComfortTarget.counterSignal: Parfum at position 6 and SLES at position 2 are plausible comfort counter-signals, so targeting does not imply universal tolerability.
